version.description: Schema version. Bump on breaking changes.

id.description: Composition id. Compiled to data-composition-id on the root div. MUST be 'main' to match the repo convention (window.__timelines['main'], data-composition-id='main').

width.description: Composition width px -> data-width. 1920(16:9), 1080(9:16), 1280(720p). Other ints allowed but these are the verified template sizes.

fps.description: Frames per second. Passed to render as --fps. Does NOT appear in HTML; stored so preview/export agree.

duration.description: Total timeline length in seconds -> root data-duration. The compiler derives this as max(clip.start+clip.length) if clips exceed it, but the stored value is authoritative for the root attribute.

_idSeq.description: Persisted seeded clip-id counter. Internal: makes clip ids deterministic AND stable across builds (the open-question resolution). Never authored by hand.

fonts.description: Local @font-face declarations the compiler emits in <style>. Google Fonts are forbidden (determinism). Paths are RELATIVE to the compiled index.html dir.

src.description: Relative path to a .ttf, e.g. 'assets/fonts/poppins-700.ttf'. Compiler copies/symlinks the file into the compiled dir.

assets.description: Asset registry keyed by assetId. Clips reference assets by id (source). Decouples 'which file' from 'how it is placed', so relink is one edit. Paths are project-relative or absolute on disk; the compiler resolves them to paths relative to the compiled index.html.

kind.description: Asset media kind. (Text clips carry no asset.)

path.description: Path to the media file on disk (project-relative or absolute).

license.description: Optional path to the <file>.license.json (license-auditor gate). Carried through, not validated by the compiler.

naturalDuration.description: Source media duration in seconds (from ffprobe), used to clamp trims. Optional.

tracks.description: Ordered tracks, index 0 = bottom layer. Track order maps DIRECTLY to data-track-index (z-order) on emitted clips: track[0] -> data-track-index=0, etc. Audio-only tracks render <audio> elements (no z-order paint, but index still assigned).

kind.description: visual = image/video/text clips paint to DOM; audio = audio clips only.

clips.description: Clips on this track. v1 does NOT enforce non-overlap on visual tracks (overlap = cross-fade authored via keyframes); the compiler emits them in array order so later clips paint on top within the same track.

id.description: Globally-unique, stable clip id (e.g. 'clip_a1b2c3'). Every mutate tool addresses a clip by this id. Generated as 'clip_' + 6 hex chars from a SEEDED counter (NO Math.random/Date.now -> determinism).

type.description: Clip type. Determines the emitted element: image->div with background-image OR img, video-><video class=clip muted playsinline>, text-><div class=clip>, audio-><audio>.

source.description: assetId into the top-level assets map. REQUIRED for image/video/audio; ABSENT for text. This is the single relink point.

start.description: Timeline start time in seconds -> data-start. Rounded to 3 decimals (matches scene/align precision, avoids GSAP seek jitter).

trim.description: Source media trim. Only for video/audio. trim.in -> data-media-start (playback offset). length is the played window; (trim.in+length) must be <= asset.naturalDuration.

in.description: Seconds into the source where playback begins -> data-media-start.

text.description: REQUIRED for type=text. The text content (HTML-escaped by the compiler before injection at BUILD time, never inside tl.call()).

position.description: Layout box in composition px (absolute positioning). Defaults to full-frame inset:0 for image/video, centered auto-box for text.

x.description: Left in px from composition origin.

w.description: Width px. Omit for full-frame media (uses inset:0).

h.description: Height px. Omit for full-frame media.

anchor.description: How x/y are interpreted. center -> translate(-50%,-50%).

style.description: Static CSS for the element, emitted at BUILD time (not animated). Whitelisted keys only; compiler renders them into an inline style string.

zIndexBoost.description: Added on top of the track-derived z-index for in-track ordering.

transform.description: Base (t=0 of the clip) transform/opacity. These are the GSAP-supported props (opacity,x,y,scale,scaleX,scaleY,rotation). The compiler emits a gsap.set(...) at the clip's start, then applies keyframes relative to this base.

keyframes.description: Ordered animation steps for THIS clip only. Each becomes a gsap.to() at an ABSOLUTE timeline time = clip.start + at. Only GSAP-supported props allowed (opacity,x,y,scale,scaleX,scaleY,rotation,width,height). v1 emits gsap.set at clip.start (base) then one gsap.to per keyframe -> deterministic, paused, finite.

at.description: Seconds RELATIVE to clip.start when this keyframe is reached.

dur.description: Tween duration in seconds (the gsap.to duration). Finite only.

props.description: Target values for this step. Keys limited to GSAP-supported animatable props.

audio.description: Audio params for type=video (its split <audio>) and type=audio.

mute.description: If true on a video clip, no <audio> companion is emitted.

meta.description: Free-form provenance carried through compile untouched (e.g. transcript section id, b-roll note, scene peak). Used by transcript/scene tooling; never read by the compiler.
